sources.title: pai-bert-tiny-zh · Models
sources.snippet: This project provides Chinese pre-trained language models and various types of NLP tools. The models are pre-trained on the large-scale corpora hosted by the Alibaba PAI team.

At the same time, huggingface.co provides the effect of pai-bert-tiny-zh install, users can directly use pai-bert-tiny-zh installed effect in huggingface.co for debugging and trial.

sources.title: Meet PAI-BERT-Tiny-ZH: Alibaba's Ultra-Lightweight Answer to Real-Time ...
sources.snippet: Enter PAI-BERT-Tiny-ZH, a highly compact, encoder-only language model developed by Alibaba's PAI team. Now hosted on Modelers.cn—the rapidly growing Huawei Ascend AI ecosystem platform—this model is specifically designed to bridge the gap between high-performance deep learning and resource-constrained deployment environments.
